notes.content: Action without thought is not action, but habit.
We read to be less alone in thinking.
The point is not the argument, but the reader it produces.
History is not the past. It is the argument we keep having about the past.
Statistics do not replace judgement; they discipline it.
What is remembered depends on where you stood when it happened.
Freedom is only real when it is inconvenient to someone.
A good question is worth more than a fast answer.
Every habit starts as a decision you have to keep making.
The boring parts are where the work actually happens.
Attention is the rarest currency in the room.
Write for the version of yourself who has to understand it later.
The map is not the territory, and the score is not the music.
Nothing ages faster than an opinion you never revisited.
Reading is the cheapest way to be somewhere else.
A system that cannot be explained cannot be improved.
